q: 我头疼，很___休息一下。
en: I have a headache and would really like to rest for a bit.

q: 我有点儿___睡觉了。
en: I feel a bit like going to sleep now.

q: 医生，我非常___知道检查结果。
en: Doctor, I am very keen to know the test results.

q: 我很___参加这次培训，可是那天要出差。
en: I would really like to attend this training, but I have a business trip that day.

q: 虽然很___早点儿下班回家，但是今天的报告还没写完。
en: Although I would love to leave work early and go home, today's report is not finished yet.

q: 你___喝点儿热水吗？
en: Would you like to drink some hot water?

q: 今天没有胃口，不___吃午饭。
en: I have no appetite today and do not feel like having lunch.

q: 他很___早点儿退休，多陪陪家人。
en: He would very much like to retire early and spend more time with his family.

q: 我出差三天了，很___我的女儿。
en: I have been away on business for three days and I miss my daughter a lot.

q: 我___他今天不会来上班了。
en: I don't think he will come to work today.

q: 让我___一下，明天再告诉你。
en: Let me think it over, and I will tell you tomorrow.

q: 他一个人在外地工作，常常___家。
en: He works alone in another city and often feels homesick.

q: 为了提高效率，大家都在___办法。
en: To improve efficiency, everyone is trying to come up with a way.

q: 我___他是不是生病了，今天没来上班。
en: I wonder whether he is ill; he did not come to work today.

q: 搬到新办公室以后，我有点儿___老同事。
en: Since moving to the new office, I have missed my old colleagues a bit.

q: 他看着电脑发呆，不知道在___什么。
en: He is staring blankly at the computer; who knows what he is thinking about.

q: 护士，我___一杯热水。
en: Nurse, I would like a cup of hot water.

q: 在药店，我___两盒感冒药。
en: At the pharmacy, I will take two boxes of cold medicine.

q: 你___什么？这里有茶，也有咖啡。
en: What would you like? We have tea and also coffee.

q: 开会前，我___一份今天的销售报告。
en: Before the meeting, I want a copy of today's sales report.

q: 不管多忙，我一定___做完这份报告。
en: No matter how busy I am, I am determined to finish this report.

q: 这两种药，我___这个，不要那个。
en: Of these two medicines, I will take this one, not that one.

q: 这台电脑太旧了，我___一台新的。
en: This computer is too old; I want a new one.

q: 老板，我们___三台打印机，两台不够用。
en: Boss, we need three printers; two are not enough.

q: 十点半___开会，大家快准备一下。
en: The meeting starts at half past ten; everyone get ready quickly.

q: 下个月我们公司___搬到新楼里，已经定了。
en: Our company is moving into a new building next month; it is already decided.

q: 从公司到医院开车___二十分钟。
en: It takes twenty minutes to drive from the company to the hospital.

q: 做一次全面检查___多长时间？
en: How long does a full check-up take?

q: 这个药很贵，一盒___两百多块。
en: This medicine is expensive; one box costs over two hundred yuan.

q: 快八点了，我___迟到了！
en: It is almost eight; I am going to be late!

q: 病人出院以后，每天___按时吃药。
en: After leaving hospital, the patient must take the medicine on time every day.

q: 写完这份报告至少___三个小时。
en: Finishing this report takes at least three hours.

q: 医生说，你的病快___好了。
en: The doctor says your illness is about to get better.

q: 这里是医院，请___大声说话。
en: This is a hospital; please do not talk loudly.

q: 我们明天早上得去公司吗？不___，在家上班就行。
en: Do we have to go to the office tomorrow morning? No need; working from home is fine.

q: 病人需要安静，你们___在这里吵闹。
en: Patients need quiet; do not make noise here.

q: 医生说我只是小感冒，___吃药，多休息就行。
en: The doctor says it is just a mild cold, so I do not need medicine; resting is enough.

q: 今天是周日，我们___上班。
en: Today is Sunday, so we do not have to go to work.

q: 我最近压力很大，真的___见任何人。
en: I have been under a lot of stress lately and really do not feel like seeing anyone.

q: 你感冒还没好，___喝冰水。
en: Your cold has not cleared up yet; don't drink iced water.

q: 我得打印出来吗？不___，发邮件就行。
en: Do I have to print it out? No need; sending an email is enough.

q: 孩子还在发烧，你千万___让他一个人在家。
en: The child still has a fever; whatever you do, don't leave him home alone.

q: 今天九点开会，我们八点半就___出发。
en: The meeting is at nine today, so we have to set off at half past eight.

q: 他的病好了，___再吃药了。
en: He is better now and does not need to take medicine any more.

q: 我的牙疼得睡不着，明天___去看牙医，不能再拖了。
en: My tooth hurts so much I cannot sleep; I have to see the dentist tomorrow and cannot put it off any longer.

q: 这个月的数据很多，我们___加班才能做完。
en: There is a lot of data this month; we have to work overtime to finish.

q: 感冒药吃完了，下班后我___去药店买一盒。
en: The cold medicine is finished; after work I have to go to the pharmacy and buy a box.

q: 汤很烫，你___等一会儿再喝。
en: The soup is very hot; you have to wait a little before drinking it.

q: 我今天___早点儿回家，孩子发烧了。
en: I have to go home early today; my child has a fever.

q: 我很___一个安静的办公室。
en: I would really like a quiet office.

q: 她很___一把新椅子，旧的坐着腰疼。
en: She would really like a new chair; the old one hurts her back.

q: 这种药太苦了，我不___它。
en: This medicine is too bitter; I do not want it.

q: 我们部门很___两个新同事，现在人手不够。
en: Our department would really like two new colleagues; we are short-handed now.

q: 你___什么颜色的笔记本？
en: What colour of notebook would you like?

q: 我___一杯热茶，谢谢。
en: I would like a cup of hot tea, please.

q: 只要给我加班费，我___周末来公司。
en: As long as I am paid overtime, I am willing to come to the company at the weekend.

q: 你___帮我检查一下这份文件吗？
en: Would you be willing to help me check this document?

q: 他不___做手术，因为他很害怕。
en: He is not willing to have the operation because he is very afraid.

q: 我很___和你一起工作，希望以后还有机会。
en: I am very willing to work with you and hope there will be another chance.

q: 他不___天天加班，所以换了工作。
en: He was not willing to work overtime every day, so he changed jobs.

q: 你发烧了，___去医院看看。
en: You have a fever; you should go to the hospital and get checked.

q: 你不___一直坐着不动，对腰不好。
en: You should not sit still all the time; it is bad for your back.

q: 我___明年换一份新工作，现在正在找。
en: I plan to change to a new job next year and am looking now.

q: 你___什么时候去做体检？
en: When are you planning to go for your check-up?

q: 会议九点开始，现在八点五十，小王___已经到了。
en: The meeting starts at nine and it is ten to nine; Xiao Wang should already be here.
